name: avo-mcp-server
description: Avo is the data governance platform that keeps every analytics event defined consistently, implemented reliably, and trusted across every team. The Avo MCP connects Claude to your tracking plan, so it can search your events, properties, and metrics, and design tracking from a PRD or Figma onto an Avo branch based on existing patterns and rules. Developers and their coding agents can then implement correctly without leaving Claude, using the code snippets and implementation instructions the Avo MCP generates. Because Avo knows your metric definitions, Claude can query your product data accurately in tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, Snowflake or BigQuery.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Avo MCP — read and edit your Avo tracking plan on a branch. Start: call list_workspaces, then set the active workspaceId.

Tools (call describe_tool(tool:"<name>") for the full shape):
- list_workspaces — list workspaces; pick one and set workspaceId.
- describe_tool — this index: describe_tool() for the map, describe_tool(tool:"save_items", type:"<type>", op:"<op>") for a field contract.
- search — find items by meaning (query) or structural filters. itemType: event, property, metric, event_variant, category, property_bundle, source, destination, group_type, gateway, journey.
- get — fetch ONE item by id/name (event, property, metric, event_variant, category, property_bundle, source, destination, group_type, gateway); workspace_config takes no id; journey by id; get(type:"branch") by branchId/branchName.
- save_items — create/update/archive/unarchive on a branch. types: event, property, event_variant, property_bundle, metric, destination, source, group_type, category, gateway. Call describe_tool(tool:"save_items", type:"<type>") before your first write of a type.
- workflow — branch ops: create_branch, update_branch_description, pull_main, set_source_language, import.
- give_feedback — send product feedback.
- list_branches — list branches.

Writing rules: writes are always on a branch (open one with workflow create_branch), never on main; the MCP never merges — that is a human step in the Avo web app. Resolve names to ids with get/search before writing; never invent ids.

tool.name: list_workspaces
tool.description:
List the Avo workspaces you have access to. Returns name + workspaceId for each. This is usually the first call in a session — every other tool (`search`, `get`, `save_items`, `workflow`) takes a `workspaceId`.

Use cases:
- Starting a fresh session.
- Switching context between client workspaces.
- Confirming auth scope before a write.

tool.name: search
tool.description:
Find tracking-plan items in two modes, auto-selected by params.

(1) Semantic search — pass query for similarity. Cap 20, default 10; index may lag recent changes.

(2) Structured listing — pass filters (e.g. tags, includeVariants) for exact matches across events, properties, metrics, event variants; or itemType with no query to enumerate source/destination/group_type/gateway/journey. event/property accept a checkpoint lens (see field). Branch + keyset pagination; filter listings cap 500, default 10; enumerations unpaged, journey 25/100.

Query with filters is rejected; use get for id lookups.

tool.name: save_items
tool.description:
Create, update, archive, or unarchive tracking-plan items in one branch-scoped batch (max 50). Each item is an envelope {op, type, id?, name?, tempId?, fields?}; op defaults to "create". type: event, property, event_variant, property_bundle, metric, destination, source, group_type, category, gateway (camelCase aliases ok).

Call describe_tool(tool:"save_items", type:"<type>", op:"<op>") for a type's exact fields — served on demand, not advertised here.

Contract:
- Writes need an open draft branch (open one via workflow create_branch; rejected on main). The MCP never merges to main.
- Identify: create takes name (event_variant: nameSuffix + a caller-supplied variantId + baseEventId); update/archive/unarchive take the identity id via id or fields (event→eventId, event_variant→baseEventId+variantId). Resolve names to ids with get/search first; never invent ids.
- $tmp: set tempId on a create, then reference it as "$tmp:<tempId>" in another same-batch item's id/ref fields; the server resolves them before saving.
- Placement: scalar renames go in fields.set; collection deltas (add*/remove*/clear*) at fields top level.
- Owner/stakeholder changes are branch-independent — they take effect immediately workspace-wide, not undone by discarding the branch.

id.description: Identity id for update/archive/unarchive on single-id types (event→eventId, …). event_variant passes its ids in fields.

type.description: Item type (snake_case; camelCase aliases accepted). Call describe_tool(tool:"save_items", type:<type>) for its fields.

fields.description: Fields for (type, op). Call describe_tool(tool:"save_items", type:<type>, op:<op>) for the contract. Optional; archive needs only id (event_variant: both ids).

tempId.description: Create only: same-batch cross-reference id; reference it as "$tmp:<tempId>".

items.description: Items to create, update, archive, or unarchive. Each item is an envelope {op, type, id?, name?, tempId?, fields?}; op defaults to "create".

branchId.description: Id of an open draft branch to stage these changes on (writes rejected on main/master). Get one from search/get, or open one via workflow create_branch.

workspaceId.description: The workspace ID. If not provided, uses the active workspace set via save_workspace.

onReviewedBranch.description: Ack for writing to a branch in review (protected main). Omitted → the write is REJECTED so approvals aren't silently invalidated. {kind:"revertToDraft"} reverts the branch to Draft and applies edits; {kind:"reject"} is the default.

tool.name: workflow
tool.description:
Open branches and edit branch metadata. For tracking-plan item edits use save_items. Call describe_tool(tool:"workflow", action:"import") for the import payload schema.

Actions:
- create_branch { branchName, description? }
- update_branch_description { branchId or branchName, description }
- pull_main { branchId } — pull latest main (Codegen; main wins on overlap).
- set_source_language { sourceId, language, branchId or branchName } — find sourceId via search(itemType:"source").
- import { branchId, format:"csv"|"json_schema", payload, importMethod? } — bulk-import (Admin).

_published_faq.name: How do I add avo-mcp-server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add avo-mcp-server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.avo.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
